paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: (left) and (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve .
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E percentage for different LLaMA-2 models with varying SFT configurations. The horizontal axis represents the model categories, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-E (%)", ranging from 0 to 50 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 10. Each model category is represented by a group of four bars, colored according to the legend: blue for "no SFT", yellow for "+ SFT on D0", purple for "+ SFT on D0, D1", and pink for "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2". For LLaMA-2-7B, the bars have approximate values of 4, 20, 27, and 30, respectively. For LLaMA-2-13B, the values are around 8, 31, 37, and 39, and for LLaMA-2-70B, the values are approximately 27, 45, 49, and 50. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, but the categories are arranged in ascending order of model size from left to right. No bars are visually emphasized.
